subject: english
question:
Rearrange the parts of the sentence in correct order.

We are encouraged

P. help accelerate their return to

Q. by how women are embracing online

R. work and promote economic mobility

S. learning to develop new skills that can
solution:
The correct option is **"QSPR".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• The **correct order** to form a meaningful sentence is **QSPR. **
 
• The sentence when rearranged will be - We are encouraged,** Q.** by how women are embracing online, **S**. learning to develop new skills that can, **P**. help accelerate their return to, R. work and promote economic mobility.

The **sentence in the correct order **would be:

 
• ***We are encouraged by how women are embracing online learning to develop new skills that can help accelerate their return to work and promote economic mobility.​​***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• A sentence is composed of a** few fundamental components. **
 
• In this instance, the order in which these elements of speech are utilized to produce a grammatically valid phrase is referred to as sentence structure or sentence structuring. 
 
• You just need to be aware of three things when it comes to basic sentence structure:
 
• **Subject predicate (verb or verb phrase)**
 
• **Directly or indirectly **
 
• The **four main types **of sentence formations in **standard grammar** are:
 
 
• **Simple sentences**
 
• **Compound sentences**
 
• **Complex sentences**
 
• **Compound-complex sentences**
